title: Roswell/Corona crash confirmed via Ed Mitchell and Admiral Wilson

tellings.quote: I had my uh information I got from Ed Mitchell at a science advisory board meeting about the Greer briefings on the disclosure project at at the Pentagon and then Admiral Wilson coming back and verifying that the Roswell crash well the Corona crash actually really did happen. It wasn't a mogul balloon.

plain: The 1947 crash near Roswell, New Mexico, which the scientist Eric W. Davis prefers to call the Corona crash after the nearby ranch, was a real crash and not a Mogul balloon, a secret Army balloon project, according to what Davis says he was told. Davis, a scientist who has advised the Pentagon, says he got this through the Apollo astronaut Ed Mitchell, after Pentagon briefings by Steven Greer, an activist whose Disclosure Project pushed for UFO secrets to be released. He says a Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson came back and confirmed the crash had happened, which, if true, would mean the official balloon explanation is wrong.
